Ivanhoe, Banyule

Administratively Ivanhoe is Banyule. Geographically it is northern Melbourne. There are roughly 12,171 residents in Ivanhoe. Quotes for Ivanhoe carry no travel line, the same as everywhere else in Banyule.

Ivanhoe clears the bar at roughly 20 searches a month, which is the only test applied to any suburb here. Ivanhoe shows near 20 a month for gutters on top of this, and doing gutters in the same visit is what makes it worth it.

Nothing published names Ivanhoe in any way we can point at, and plenty of sites would write an Ivanhoe job in anyway. Doing the glass in Ivanhoe is the same work either way.

Marks on glass

Spotting, and what causes it

Soft water helps here

The mains supply comes largely from closed catchments with very little dissolved mineral in it, so clean glass dries clean.

A marked window is a clue

In Ivanhoe it usually means a sprinkler is hitting the glass, or something above it is shedding onto it. Either way the mains supply is not the cause.

Etching does not come back

Deposit left to bake on sun facing glass for years has gone into the surface. Cleaning improves it and does not restore it, and you should hear that first.

Hard to reach

Skylights, voids and fixed panels

Skylights

Reachable from the roof or from a pole, and almost never included unless somebody asks. They make a noticeable difference to a room.

Stairwell and void glazing

High, fixed and awkward. The pane in an Ivanhoe house most likely to have never been cleaned.

Glass over a roof line

Above a lower roof, a deck or a pool. It needs a pole and a plan rather than a ladder and an arm.

Height and safety

Second storey glass, safely

Second storey window cleaning is the job people most often try themselves and most often should not, and the reason is specific.

A ladder has nothing to grip

Leaned against glass or a glazing bar, a ladder has no friction and no structure behind it. It is a different proposition to a ladder against a gutter, which is already a risky enough thing.

Most Ivanhoe double storey glass is reachable from the ground with a water fed pole, which removes the problem entirely.
